subject: FinScale: Dedicated GPU sizing & isolation workshop — scheduling
messages:
From: Sam D'Angelo <sam.dangelo@finscale.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carmen Lee <carmen.lee@finscale.com>
Date: 2027-04-20T14:22:00-04:00
Subject: Dedicated GPU sizing + isolation review — request for workshop slot

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week — the FinScale infra team would like to follow up with a focused technical workshop to align on required pool sizing, autoscaling behavior, and isolation options for our dedicated deployment.

Rough goals for the session:
- Validate peak and steady-state throughput assumptions
- Walk through isolation patterns (tenant pinning, dedicated slices)
- Discuss autoscale cooldowns, burst capacity, and fallback models
- Surface any operational trade-offs that affect RPO/RTO and cost

Proposed slots (all ET):
- Tue Apr 27, 10:00–11:30
- Wed Apr 28, 15:00–16:30
- Thu Apr 29, 09:00–10:30

Attendees from our side: Sam D'Angelo (infra lead), Carmen Lee (platform), and an engineer from our infra team (may join as infra@finscale.com).

Can you confirm availability and whether Redwood would run a short demo of the autoscaling behavior as part of the session? If helpful, we can share a short traffic profile ahead of time.

Thanks,
Sam

--
Sam D'Angelo
Head of Infrastructure, FinScale
sam.dangelo@finscale.com
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Sam D'Angelo <sam.dangelo@finscale.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-21T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated GPU sizing + isolation review — request for workshop slot

Hi Sam — thanks for the clear goals. We can run the workshop and include a short live demo showing autoscale + fallback to a smaller-quantized variant.

Availability (PST):
- Tue Apr 27, 07:00–08:30 PT (your 10:00–11:30 ET) — OK for our infra leads
- Wed Apr 28, 12:00–13:30 PT — prefer this window for a deeper run-through
- Thu Apr 29, 06:00–07:30 PT — less ideal due to team travel

Pre-reads I will circulate: a one-page capacity assumptions spreadsheet and a topology diagram that shows isolation modes for dedicated pools. Attaching a draft agenda and the topology image so you can react.

Quick asks:
- Can you confirm expected peak concurrent requests and typical sequence length distribution for the workload? Even rough ranges help us size KV cache and batch targets.
- Please flag any security/compliance constraints we should call out in the agenda (e.g., no external shared storage, specific KMS requirements).

I put Marissa on the thread to coordinate calendar / invite logistics.

Best,
Priyom

Attachments: Redwood_Dedicated_Workshop_Agenda_v1.pdf, topology_v2.png

--
Priyom Das
Principal Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sam D'Angelo <sam.dangelo@finscale.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-22T11:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated GPU sizing + isolation review — request for workshop slot

Thanks Priyom / Sam — looping in Hannah for ops-level runbook notes.

Sam — if Wed Apr 28 (12:00–13:30 PT / 15:00–16:30 ET) works for your team that will give us the best combination of senior engineers and ops. If you prefer Tue Apr 27 we can still do it but may need to narrow the agenda to core sizing and defer deeper failover flows.

Please confirm:
- Final attendee list + titles (so we can include role-based slides)
- Any restricted topics for the demo (e.g., cannot show live customer traffic)

I'll draft the calendar invite once you confirm attendees and preferred slot. Also, do you want a separate breakout for procurement/contract questions after the architecture session, or keep it to a technical-only workshop?

Thanks — M

--
Marissa Cole
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
From: Sam D'Angelo <sam.dangelo@finscale.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carmen Lee <carmen.lee@finscale.com>, FinScale Infra <infra@finscale.com>
Date: 2027-04-23T10:40:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated GPU sizing + isolation review — request for workshop slot

Wed Apr 28 (15:00–16:30 ET) works for us. Attendees:
- Sam D'Angelo, Head of Infrastructure
- Carmen Lee, Platform Engineering Manager
- Diego Ramirez, Senior Infrastructure Engineer (infra@finscale.com)

We prefer to keep the first session technical-only; procurement follow-up is fine to schedule separately.

Quick answers to your asks:
- Peak concurrent inference requests: ~1,200–1,800 over a 1-minute window; baseline 200–350
- Median sequence length: ~64 tokens; 95th pct: ~420 tokens for some long-tail jobs
- Compliance: data residency in us-east only, KMS with customer-managed keys is a hard requirement

We can share a small CSV with a 48-hour traffic sample if that helps sizing — will send that to Priyom by end of day Monday.

Thanks,
Sam
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Sam D'Angelo <sam.dangelo@finscale.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-25T16:30:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated GPU sizing + isolation review — request for workshop slot

Perfect — Wed Apr 28, 15:00–16:30 ET is confirmed. I just sent a calendar invite with the following items attached: Redwood_Dedicated_Workshop_Agenda_v1.pdf (agenda + roles), topology_v2.png (isolation modes), and meeting-invite.ics (joins).

Prep for the session:
- Please share the 48-hour traffic CSV (anonymized) and we will run it through a sizing script prior to the meeting.
- We will demo: autoscale (3-minute scale-up), burst fallback to quantized variant, and a short failure/recovery scenario from a simulated node loss.
- Expect a short set of action items after the workshop: recommended pool size, batch/kv cache targets, and a proposed autoscale policy (cooldown, step sizes).

If anything changes on your side, reply-all and we'll pivot. Looking forward to it.

Best,
Priyom

Attachments referenced: meeting-invite.ics

--
Priyom Das
Principal Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.ai
